WITH store AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = 'Innsbruck' AND store_name LIKE '%PowerTool%' LIMIT 1
),
target_skus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE 1=0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM target_skus ts
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM store_inventory si
  WHERE si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
    AND si.product_sku = ts.product_sku
    AND si.available_today_quantity >= 2
);
